newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barges quoted at broadly steady levels.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barges quoted at broadly steady levels.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at broadly steady levels on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No barges traded on Thursday versus none on Wednesday. Bids and offers included:
- One barge, this week, Mississippi (St. Louis) bid at 185 percent of tariff, down 15 points from previous offer.
- One barge, this week, Missouri (Jefferson City) offered at a steady 220 percent, no bid.
- Two barges, week of October 27, mid-Mississippi (McGregor and south) bid at 225 percent, down five points from similar bid, no offer.
- Two barges, week of October 27, lower Ohio bid at 215 percent, no offer or comparison.
- Two barges, one each weeks of November 3 and 10, mid-Mississippi (McGregor and south), bid at 220 percent, up 10 points from similar bid, offered at 230 percent.
